messages.subject: models/fusion fixes verified
messages.body: Patched self_audit/volume/models.py and fusion.py so zero-init controls only terminal residual projections, upstream planar/skip layers stay trainable, fixed-window defaults and architecture controls are explicit, and width/kernel/stride knobs are honored or rejected rather than ignored. Added independent regression coverage for exact old-function parity, two-step input-dependent residual learning, fork_rng preservation, architecture knob validation, CNN width tails, capacity accounting, and SkipFusion zero-init; owned tests pass 23/23, check_repo and py_compile pass. Updated reports/native_volume_pilot/models.md with APIs, hashes/evidence, and current shared-suite boundary (299 passed, 3 correction-owner failures, 1 warning); no commits, pushes, downloads, or long training performed.
